newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade gains, index slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade gains, index slightly higher.

text.p: Trade on the Latvian stock exchange increased on Tuesday and commercial bank indices tracking the market edged slightly higher, the bourse said.
Overall turnover came to 162,000 lats with market leader Unibanka notching up trade of 42,200 lats and remaining stable at 3.24 lats.
Rietumu Bank's Rietumu index rose 0.04 percent to 150.53 while Saules Bank Saule10 index gained 0.52 percent to 152.20.
Other official list share Riga Transport Fleet gained one santime to 1.69 lats on turnover of 29,900 lats while Staburadze slipped to 2.53 lats from 2.55 lats on trade of 11,300 lats.
On the secondary list, Daugavpils Chain was most active on trade of 26,400 lats and it slipped to 2.21 lats from 2.25 lats.
Other active shares included fish canneries Salacgriva on trade of 9,900 lats and Kaija on 9,700 lats. Kaija added one santime to 2.21 lats while Salacgriva was stable at 4.70 lats.
Mangali Shipyard turned over 7,400 lats and edged up two santimes to 1.07 lats.
Rigas Raugs yeast plant saw trade of 5,300 lats and it gained to four lats from 3.80 lats.
